entities.summary: Alfons Nossol is a Polish Roman Catholic prelate and theologian, who served as the Bishop of Opole from 1977 to 2009. He was elevated to the personal title of Archbishop in 1999 by Pope John Paul II. Nossol is widely recognized for his contributions to ecumenism and his pivotal role in Germany–Poland relations.
